_readme: The platform's OWN WhatsApp templates — sent from `_platform` (services/operations/app/
core/flows.py's own PLATFORM constant), never a shop's library (data/templates.seed.json).
REGISTERED AUTOMATICALLY, NEVER SUBMITTED AUTOMATICALLY (owner decision, 2026-09-10 — same
principle as the subscription-renewal Flow's own manual 'تجهيز الفلو' seed action): register()
is a local upsert with no Meta call and no cap (see core/library.py's own docstring), so
having this content ready costs nothing and needs no install-time Meta connection. Submitting
for review IS a live Meta call and STAYS a manual 'أرسل للمراجعة' click from the console —
this file only saves the operator from hand-typing the body/variables/flow_button first.
ONLY REGISTERED WHEN THE NAME DOES NOT ALREADY EXIST for `_platform` (app/core/
platform_templates.py's own seed_platform_templates) — an operator's own edit to one of
these, or a re-submission after a rejection, is never silently reverted by a later boot.
